projects.title: Projects

nexora.title: Nexora Logistics
nexora.category: Smart Logistics, Supply Chain & Fleet Management Platform
nexora.about: An enterprise-grade, multi-tenant digital logistics platform streamlining end-to-end freight, last-mile delivery, and smart warehouse operations.
nexora.description: Nexora is a scalable, enterprise logistics ecosystem engineered with Flutter to empower modern supply chains across B2B and B2C segments. Designed with dedicated workflows for Drivers, Merchants, and Warehouse Operations, the platform orchestrates parcel delivery cycles, merchant pickups, reverse logistics, industrial handheld laser PDA and camera barcode scanning, electronic Proof of Delivery (e-POD with digital signatures and OTP verification), Cash on Delivery (COD) reconciliations, real-time GPS fleet tracking, and instant WebSocket support ticketing.
nexora.feature1: Multi-Persona Architecture: Tailored portals for Couriers, Merchants, and Hub Supervisors within a unified multi-tenant environment.
nexora.feature2: Dual-Engine Scanning: Seamless integration with mobile camera scanners and industrial Android PDA laser hardware scanners.
nexora.feature3: Digital Proof of Delivery (e-POD): Touch-based customer signatures, presigned photo proofs, and secure OTP verification.
nexora.feature4: Cash on Delivery (COD) Management: Real-time parcel cash tracking, collection validation, and driver balance reconciliation.
nexora.feature5: Smart Warehousing & Intra-Hub Manifests: Shelf bin assignments, Out-for-Delivery sorting, and pallet transfer management.
nexora.feature6: Real-Time Fleet Telemetry & Support: Continuous GPS driver location tracking on interactive maps with bidirectional Socket.io chat.

rafiq.title: Rafiq
rafiq.about: A comprehensive academic e-learning platform delivering expert-led courses, HD video lectures, interactive PDF annotations, and an AI-powered smart study planner.
rafiq.description: Rafiq is an all-in-one educational platform engineered for school and university students. It combines structured video curricula, in-app interactive PDF note-taking, AI-driven weekly study scheduling, timed MCQ assessments with instant feedback, and offline download management.
rafiq.feature1: Expert-led academic courses and structured video lectures with customizable playback speeds and real-time progress tracking.
rafiq.feature2: Interactive in-app PDF viewer with digital annotation tools (highlight, underline, pen drawings, and sticky notes).
rafiq.feature3: AI-powered adaptive study planner with daily focus blocks, exam countdowns, and .ics calendar export.
rafiq.feature4: Interactive MCQ quizzes with real-time countdown timers, detailed explanations, and historical performance tracking.
rafiq.feature5: Offline downloads center for seamless offline access to lecture videos and study materials.
rafiq.feature6: Bilingual interface (Arabic & English with full RTL/LTR support) and smooth Light/Dark theme switching.

almandob.title: Almandob
almandob.about: A premier digital B2B wholesale platform connecting retail merchants and showrooms directly with manufacturers and verified suppliers at competitive prices.
almandob.description: Almandob is a robust B2B wholesale marketplace designed to streamline inventory sourcing for businesses, retail stores, and commercial showrooms. It enables buyers to order directly from certified local and international factories with transparent carton breakdowns, minimum order quantity rules, and tiered wholesale pricing. The platform features an intelligent shopping cart with promo coupon verification, loyalty rewards point calculations, frictionless guest checkout, Cash on Delivery support, itemized VAT tax invoicing, and end-to-end order lifecycle tracking.
almandob.feature1: Direct factory-to-buyer procurement from accredited domestic and international manufacturers eliminating middlemen.
almandob.feature2: Bulk ordering engine with carton quantity calculations, minimum order thresholds, and detailed piece metrics.
almandob.feature3: Dynamic wholesale cart featuring promotional discount coupons, loyalty points rewards, and Cash on Delivery.
almandob.feature4: Frictionless checkout for both authenticated commercial accounts and guest buyers with instant phone verification.
almandob.feature5: Comprehensive billing system with automated 14% VAT calculations, delivery fees, and multi-tier order tracking.
almandob.feature6: Advanced product filtering by manufacturing origin, price ranges, and factories, backed by marketing deep-link integration.

rahma.title: Rahma Healthcare
rahma.about: Rahma Healthcare is a trusted digital healthcare platform authorized by the Saudi Ministry of Health, offering voice and video consultations.
rahma.description: A comprehensive digital platform connecting users with accredited medical, psychological, and social specialists. It features in-app wallet management, secure card payments, full profile setups supporting family members, Zoom telehealth integrations, and digital medical reports.
rahma.feature1: Audio & Video Consultations: Secure, high-quality audio and video telehealth calls integrated via Zoom.
rahma.feature2: In-App Financial Wallet: Secure balance recharge, consultation bookings, and practitioner withdrawal requests.
rahma.feature3: Family Profiles Support: Ability to register family members under a single account to coordinate their care.
rahma.feature4: Smart Provider Filtering: Detailed search by specialization, fees, and genuine patient ratings.
rahma.feature5: Digital Medical Reports: Seamless retrieval of virtual prescriptions, sessions history, and digital reports.
rahma.feature6: Secure Payment Gateways: Seamless checkout support via Visa, Mada, and Apple Pay.

one_plus.title: One Plus
one_plus.about: A smart learning platform connecting students with educational centers, tutors, and structured courses across academic levels.
one_plus.description: One Plus is a comprehensive digital learning application designed to simplify education for students across all academic levels. It allows users to browse and enroll in full courses or modular chapters, stream protected video lectures with advanced anti-recording security, download course attachments & PDF exam sheets, track academic progress, and directly communicate with educational centers.
one_plus.feature1: Multi-tier course exploration filtered by educational center, academic stage, faculty, and academic year.
one_plus.feature2: Flexible enrollment options allowing full-course subscription or chapter-by-chapter purchasing.
one_plus.feature3: In-app multimedia lesson viewer with custom video controls, YouTube integration, and PDF document viewer.
one_plus.feature4: Advanced content protection with screen-recording restrictions and screenshot blocking.
one_plus.feature5: Direct communication channels with educational centers via WhatsApp and phone integration.
one_plus.feature6: Interactive reviews and rating system with course progress tracking and real-time updates.

shaghel.title: Shaghel
shaghel.about: An on-demand home maintenance marketplace connecting clients with top-rated technicians.
shaghel.description: Shaghel is a cross-platform home maintenance client built with Flutter. Featuring a dual-role flow (Client & Technician), clients can request 9+ service categories including AC repair, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, and electrical work. Requests support visual uploads and voice note recording. Technicians can manage their availability, view accumulated reward points, and track emergency or scheduled orders. A real-time Socket.io server facilitates instant communication.
shaghel.feature1: Dual-Role Architecture: Separate workflows and custom interfaces designed specifically for Clients and Service Providers.
shaghel.feature2: Multimedia Requests: Allows clients to record voice complaints, upload photos, schedule appointments, and select payment types.
shaghel.feature3: Proximity-Based Sorting: Uses Google Maps and GPS Geolocation to search and rank technicians by distance and user rating.
shaghel.feature4: Real-Time Bidirectional Chat: Instant messaging system built on Socket.io for direct chat coordination and image sharing.
shaghel.feature5: Technician Console: Integrated online/offline toggle, wallet points ledger, and paginated scroll lists for orders.
shaghel.feature6: FCM & Local Notifications: Double-layered alert infrastructure keeping both roles updated on chats, requests, and order updates.

tarh.title: Tarh
tarh.about: A modern bilingual real estate marketplace facilitating property buying, renting, and advertising with geographical mapping and integrated chats.
tarh.description: Tarh is your go-to app for real estate marketing, helping you buy, sell, or rent properties across a wide range of listings. Whether you're looking for a cozy apartment, a luxury villa, or a relaxing chalet, Tarh connects you with the right buyers or tenants.
tarh.feature1: Browse detailed listings with categorization, photo galleries, and filtering options
tarh.feature2: A structured, multi-step property creation wizard with attributes and file attachments
tarh.feature3: Google Maps interactive search to browse local property listings with custom map pins
tarh.feature4: Direct in-app messaging system connecting prospective clients with property advertisers
tarh.feature5: Multiple subscription plan tiers for advertisers with online credit card/webview payments
tarh.feature6: Bilingual layout (Arabic/English) with RTL support, custom role selection, and FCM notifications

qutouf_al_daad.title: Qutouf Al Daad
qutouf_al_daad.about: An advanced educational platform designed to make Arabic language learning interactive, engaging, and accessible for students, teachers, and parents.
qutouf_al_daad.description: Qutouf Al Daad is a comprehensive Arabic learning platform built with Flutter and Clean Architecture. The application provides a complete educational ecosystem where students can access lessons, assignments, and exams, teachers can create and manage educational content, and parents can monitor academic performance. The platform supports real-time updates, push notifications, bilingual localization, performance analytics, AI-powered assistance, and a modern user experience across Android and iOS.
qutouf_al_daad.feature1: Interactive lessons with videos, documents, and educational resources
qutouf_al_daad.feature2: Online examinations with automatic grading and performance tracking
qutouf_al_daad.feature3: Dedicated dashboards for students, teachers, and parents
qutouf_al_daad.feature4: Real-time notifications and synchronization using Firebase
qutouf_al_daad.feature5: AI-powered assistant for helping students during learning
qutouf_al_daad.feature6: Bilingual support with Arabic and English localization

future_x.title: Future X
future_x.about: Future X is an innovative mobile application designed as a digital launchpad to help you understand yourself, discover your personality traits, and identify your career interests through scientific, instant assessments.
future_x.description: Future X empowers users to discover their strengths and professional styles in a smart and streamlined way. It features a 100-question behavioral test designed by specialized scholars, generating immediate leadership trait profiles (Strategic, Loving, Analytical, or Inspirational). The app offers detailed educational guidance, career path suggestions, historical test records, custom push notifications, and payment integration for booking advanced consultations and unlocking deeper analytical reviews.
future_x.feature2: Instant Trait Profiling & Leadership Percentage Metrics
future_x.feature4: Integrated Paid Report Purchases & Online Checkout Webview
future_x.feature5: Personal History Records & Dashboard to Track Assessments
future_x.feature6: Direct Expert & Specialist Consultation Booking System

qarah.title: Qarah
qarah.about: Qarah is a digital marketplace application that connects customers needing water delivery services with local distributors, streamlining the bidding and logistics process.
qarah.description: Qarah simplifies local water supply by enabling users to submit delivery requests and receive custom quotes from nearby distributors. It supports full user cycle roles (Client & Distributor) with permission-based access, map-integrated address configurations, real-time bid comparison/selection, secure multi-channel payments, order fulfillment confirmation with review systems, and a dedicated digital wallet to manage earnings and withdrawal requests.
qarah.feature2: Interactive Map Pickers for Custom Delivery Destinations
qarah.feature3: Competitive Distributor Bidding & Price Quote Engine
qarah.feature5: Transaction Logs, History & Order Tracking Dashboards
qarah.feature6: Digital Wallet System & Bank Transfer Withdrawals

salon.title: Salon App
salon.about: A multi-service salon and barbershop booking application for men and women with real-time scheduling and secure payment options.
salon.description: Salon is a specialized grooming and beauty booking application catering to both men and women. The platform allows users to explore barbers and beauty salons, choose their preferred specialist, select custom services (such as haircutting, beard styling, coloring, and hair treatments), pick suitable time slots, and complete transactions securely via credit card or digital wallet.
salon.feature1: Customized user experiences for both men (barbershop services) and women (beauty salon care).
salon.feature2: Barber & salon discovery with detailed profiles, services list, ratings, and working hours.
salon.feature3: Interactive date and time slot picker for real-time appointment booking and rescheduling.
salon.feature4: Multi-channel payment gateway supporting Credit Card / Visa and in-app digital wallet.
salon.feature5: Itemized digital invoice (Fatora) breakdown with automated VAT and total price calculation.
salon.feature6: Push notifications via Firebase and Local Notifications for real-time booking status and reminders.

rafeeq_alderasa.title: Rafeeq Al-Derasa
rafeeq_alderasa.about: An educational marketplace connecting students with certified tutors for personalized 1-on-1 and group live sessions, equipped with study bundles and an integrated digital wallet.
rafeeq_alderasa.description: Rafeeq Al-Derasa is an educational platform designed to streamline private tutoring across all academic stages, from kindergarten and school levels to university coursework and standardized aptitude tests. The app empowers students to explore verified tutor profiles, compare qualifications, book and reschedule live study sessions, subscribe to individual and family study bundles with discount promo codes, manage payments via an in-app digital wallet, and interact directly with teachers through real-time messaging.
rafeeq_alderasa.feature1: Advanced multi-criteria tutor search and filtering by subject, academic stage, gender, rating, and years of experience.
rafeeq_alderasa.feature2: Flexible appointment scheduling system supporting instant booking, session rescheduling, and cancellations.
rafeeq_alderasa.feature3: Individual and group/family educational bundles offering multi-session packages with promo code validation.
rafeeq_alderasa.feature4: Integrated real-time chat infrastructure facilitating direct communication between students and tutors.
rafeeq_alderasa.feature5: In-app digital wallet supporting balance deposits, seamless session checkouts, and comprehensive transaction ledgers.
rafeeq_alderasa.feature6: Rigorous multi-step tutor onboarding with identity verification, university degree uploads, and credential audits.
